note: Run against the built bundle served by vite preview, not a dev server, so nothing passes because of a dev-only transform. The chain data is a real composition run, not a fixture.

tests.name: core path › the first screen names the outcome and the two things that make it hard
core path › every route in the nav loads and keeps the selected covenant
core path › a route that does not exist says nothing is being withheld
core path › a deep link survives a reload
core path › an unreachable node is shown as an outage, never as an empty result
core path › the status page says what breaks when a service is down
proof path › a bad operation id cannot be submitted

proof path › a real operation verifies inside two minutes, with no wallet
settlement › the classification and every observation are shown separately
settlement › the observer never shows a live approval count
privacy › no route persists anything private

privacy › the bundle carries no analytics or tag manager
privacy › the incident room shows the shape of the private state and never its contents

limitations: The chain-dependent assertions need VINCT_COVENANT and VINCT_OPERATION from a real run. Without them they skip rather than pass, because a green tick for a test that read nothing is worse than a skip.
Local stack only. The same suite against Devnet needs a funded deployment.
Fonts are substituted per design.md's own substitution list. Proportions, tracking, and weights survive; the exact letterforms do not.
